notes.title: Update Available. Framerate Improved.
notes.content:
Hello, we want to tell you that an update is available. 

in this patch the framerate was improved, some problems of the camera were fixed and the health of the enemies was balanced, besides that we added extra content to the levels and design improvements. enjoy

tags.bug: some problems of the camera were fixed

tags.balance_change: the health of the enemies was balanced

tags.feature: we added extra content to the levels and design improvements
